title: Ran Carthon plans to reach out to Brandon Aiyuk

sources.name: Yahoo Sports NFL
sources.title: Ran Carthon plans to reach out to Brandon Aiyuk
sources.description: At a time when it's not clear whether receiver Brandon Aiyuk is getting any advice — or whether he's listening to the advice he's getting — a former NFL G.M. who knows Aiyuk plans to connect with him.
